lines.t: The light unfolds in spirals of rest,
Thunder slow beneath the chest,
Word of the Eternal breathes in bass,
The seventh pulse resets the space.
The Voice rides the storm of time,
Speaking peace through every sign,
The earth turns still, the rhythm slows,
Speaking peace through every sign,
The earth turns still, the rhythm slows,
Where His mercy endlessly flows.
Shabbat… the signal through the void,
The chaos quiet, noise destroyed,
Law and love entwine as flame,
Written deep inside His name.
Shabbat Shalom — break the sound and bend the bone,
Fire in the temple tone,
Holy rest, divine unknown,
Shabbat Shalom — the cycle throne.
Truth descends in ultraviolet hue,
Every shadow calls for something new,
The soul awakens, stripped of pride,
The Sabbath pulls the worlds aside.
Hear the hidden thunder’s vow,
The Lamb is resting even now,
The silence roars, dimensions fall,
The peace of God consumes it all.
Waves of vow — echo deep inside,
Every truth aligned, none denied,
Rest is not escape but flame,
Where all creation bears His Name.
Shabbat Shalom — break the sound and bend the bone,
Burn the night within the tone,
Spirit storm, return to throne,
Shabbat Shalom — eternal zone.
Sabbath cycles open wide,
Heaven and earth coincide,
The pulse of peace, exploding bright,
Shabbat complete — in endless light.
Shabbat Shalom
